The '''Vulcusion system''' was located in the [[Vulcusion sector/Legends|Vulcusion sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="Western Reaches" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the confrontation known as the [[Battle of Vulcusion]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vulcusion [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square L-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
